clips.name: idle_cruise
clips.note: Cruise hover: bob +-0.12 b over 80 t, a +-1.5 degree wobble, the arch tilted 35 and rocking +-20 degrees, the pendulum lagging; halo 2.25, inner ring -4.5, brim 4.5, medallions 4.5 / -6.75, pods 11.25 degrees per tick (whole turns per loop).

clips.name: field_idle
clips.note: Field hover: the stack spread, the pods orbiting 1.5 degrees per tick, the arch turning round the hanging core like a gyroscope, the violet column and link beams.

clips.name: idle_dormant
clips.note: Dormant: folded on the floor, still.

clips.name: hold_coreup
clips.note: Core-up rest pose (form/coreup).

clips.name: hold_tower
clips.note: Tower rest pose (form/tower).

clips.name: hold_laser
clips.note: Laser rest pose (form/laser): the medallions counter-orbit at 5 degrees per tick with their beams.

clips.name: hold_deployed
clips.note: Deployed rest pose (form/deployed): the lances far out.

clips.name: glide
clips.note: Travel: nose down 6 degrees, the pendulum swung back 10 degrees, the pods trailing a little.

clips.name: entrance
clips.note: Dormant -> cruise (untargetable until about 110): clank (16), pods drop and the device lifts to 2.6 b (24-30), halo / inner ring / core rise out of the hole and the plates and pendulum drop while it lifts to 3.0 b (30-48), the eye opens (54, iris and slit idle), the arch turns 90 degrees (60-78), the rise 3.0 -> 4.5 b with the stack settling to cruise spacing (80-110), settled (115).

clips.name: bomb_run
clips.note: C1 bombing run: nose down 18 degrees (0-10, slit hot), ports glowing (10), bombs from 12 to 56 at port_0..7 (the module drops them along its glide), level out (56-58) into the first pose of slam, which the module plays at 58 for the finisher (column, plunge, impact).

clips.name: slam
clips.note: C2 slam: the core face down and the gold column to the floor (0-13, 13 t tell), the plunge 4.5 -> 2.3 b (13-16, ease in, stack compressed), slam (16), sit 7 t, rise (23-44).

clips.name: laser
clips.note: C3 lasers: medallions drop to r 2.8, y -2.0 (0-4), charge (4-23, medals hot), beams extend 0 -> 3.74 b over 23-25 (48 degrees from vertical: floor spots on r 5.5 at H 4.5), from 25 they orbit at exactly 5 degrees per tick for 133 t (eye: az 90 -> -575; gear: -90 -> 575; the spots meet in front at 43, then every 36 t, back and front), beams off at 158-160, retract and re-dock (159-175). The module aims its line hazards at the same yaw every tick (manifest orbit).

clips.name: missiles
clips.note: C4 missiles: slit hot and the spikes tip up 10 degrees (0-8, flare at the tips), the eye up and the arch flat, the gold vent column up 6 b (8-21), launches 22-35 at vent_l / vent_r, column off (38), back (64).

clips.name: tower_throw
clips.note: C6 rock throw: dip to 2.8 b with a 27 degree roll (0-12), vent column up and the medallions flung to +-5.5 b (12-20), rise and level while the tower telescopes up (20-38: tiers +1.35 / +2.0, halo x1.7 at +3.2, spikes and iris spike up), flame band 38-55 (fx), bursts from 55 every 6 t, throws from 95 every 8 t, revert (142-157) with a 20 degree roll wobble.

clips.name: coreup
clips.note: C5 core flip-up: spark (0), the eye out (1-4), gold flash and lift (5-15: core to +2.8 b, arch upright, brim 25, spikes up and the medallions to the ring ends facing forward, iris spike up, roll 10), hold (16-28), the up-beam (29-40, column up 6 b), the core drops back toward the ring with the column down to the floor (40-44), blast (48), hold, settle back (81-130).

clips.name: warp_out
clips.note: Warp out: the halo flips upright and spins while the device pitches nose-up 35 degrees (0-11), vis 1 -> 0 in 1 t (11-12), hidden from 12 to the end (the module flashes and moves the body to the arena centre at 13, then plays warp_in_field at 34).

clips.name: warp_in_field
clips.note: Warp in at the new spot: vis 0 -> 1 (0-2) at ring centre 5.8 b, the unfold to the field form in 16 t (1-17), the link beams and the violet column (17-21). Call look/field at unfold.

clips.name: wave
clips.note: 「인력 충격파」: the charge sphere grows with 4 pulses (0-24), the 1 t gold beam down and the burst flare at 25 (impact: the front leaves the axis; the module runs it).

clips.name: wave_long
clips.note: The third 「인력 충격파」: a 40 t charge, the beam and impact at 41.

clips.name: wave_drop
clips.note: The third wave with the drop: the charge sinks the device 0.5 b (0-36), the drop -2.9 b in 4 t onto the floor with the stack compressed (ring centre 2.4 b, the core on the floor; 36-40), the beam and burst on landing (40-41), grounded 19 t, the lift-off pulse (60) and the rise (60-80).

clips.name: field_erupt
clips.note: F1 감소 영역 activation: the arch slows and locks facing the front and the eye looks out (0-12, slit hot), the gold eruption pulse from the core (22: glow flash, the device bobs up 0.15 b), back to the field hover (22-40). The module runs the 9 eruption events on its own clock (play it again for a later activation).

clips.name: frock
clips.note: F2 rock throw in the field form: the vent column up (0-8), the flame band (8-25, fx), bursts from 25, throws from 65, back (100-110).

clips.name: field_end
clips.note: Unbroken field end: lift-off flash (0) and a 20 t rise, the lances out (20-40: the spikes and medallions to +-5.6 b, first vertical down, then horizontal at 40), the pack-up roll and rock (50-72), the lances dock and the core swings up into the hole, the pods tuck, violet fades (72-96; call look/idle at 72).

clips.name: break
clips.note: 역장 붕괴 (the 20th hit; call crack/4 first): the bubble flares (0-5), bursts (5-7: scale 1 -> 1.6 -> 0), the whole device tilts 28 degrees in 9 t (5-14), a damped wobble +-8 -> 0 (14-34) while it sinks toward the groggy slump; link beams, violet column and the Ousia flame go out.

clips.name: groggy
clips.note: Groggy slump: ring centre 3.3 b, roll 25 and pitch 8, the stack compressed round the sunk core, slit off / eye dim (look/groggy), halo slid and tilted, pods slow, the pendulum swinging +-12, a slow +-3 wobble. Hittable, no attacks.

clips.name: recover
clips.note: Recovery: re-level 6 t, the core flips to the top 9 t (the arch swings over), back to cruise (call look/idle at 0).

clips.name: death
clips.note: Death: the seam flickers hot / off three times (0-18), the eye fades; the halo drops and rolls off, the pods stop and fall, the spikes droop 45, the ring tilts 30 and sinks until its low rim rests on the floor (ring centre 2.45 b) over 40 t (20-60), the pendulum topples over, the medallions clatter down; vis scales out (70-110). Call kill after 110.

bomb.note: a falling bomb: a 0.65 b dark bronze sphere with a gold band and a glowing seam (summon at a port anchor, then tp it down with teleport_duration)

missile.note: a gold drill missile, 1.4 b, point down (-Y in its frame): turn it with its transformation or summon it rotated
